The Kashmir Files

The campaign for The Kashmir Files boosted the film's visibility through strategic content creation, consistent posting and influencer engagement. It combined humour, emotional appeal and trending hashtags to make the campaign memorable and relatable, which led to high interaction, widespread discussion and strong resonance across social platforms. Hashtags trended at No. 1, showing the campaign's extensive reach.

Sony LIV Originals02 / 09

Bada Naam Karenge

Credtech executed the Bada Naam Karenge campaign for Sony LIV Originals and created a viral wave across social platforms. Strategic content, consistent posting and influencer engagement boosted visibility, while humour, emotional appeal and trending hashtags made the campaign memorable. Hashtags trended at No. 1, and the multi-platform strategy positioned the show as a cultural and social talking point.

▲ 270M+ audience
Read the case study →
Hotstar03 / 09

Harikatha

The Harikatha on Hotstar campaign surpassed its targets on Instagram and X (Twitter). On Instagram it reached over 78 lakh people against a target of 70 lakh, through 35 posts from 35 pages, generating 8.35 lakh views. On X it engaged over 17 lakh people against a 15 lakh target, with 38 posts from 38 influencers, and #HarikathaonHotstar trended at No. 1 nationally for over an hour with 84 lakh impressions. In total the campaign reached 6,202,871 people with 8,452,720 impressions and 2,155 tweets from 1,527 users.

▲ 6.2M total reach
Read the case study →

Tanaav 2

The Sony LIV Tanaav 2 campaign had an extensive social media reach, using multiple platforms to boost engagement, generate trends and increase viewership for the show. Total views and reach came to 3.47 crore, and #TanaavOnSonyLiv trended in the top 2 with 1.16 crore impressions.

▲ 1.16 Cr impressions

Film05 / 09

Thalaivi

The social media promotion of Thalaivi achieved substantial reach and engagement through a well-executed content strategy. High-performing posts reflected strong audience interest and interaction. The campaign used popular third-party pages such as “I Support Narendra Modi” and “The Chaupal” to amplify visibility among targeted audiences. Tailored content, regional relevance and emotional appeal drove conversations and created buzz around the film, showing the power of influencer networks and targeted page partnerships.

Rocket Boys

The Rocket Boys web series campaign achieved significant reach and engagement across multiple platforms through a strategic mix of content formats and a consistent posting schedule. Influencers generated buzz, while humorous and relatable creatives made the campaign more memorable. Strategic planning enhanced the show's visibility and drove high audience interaction.

Maharani Season 2

Freedom at Midnight

The Freedom at Midnight campaign used emotional storytelling, striking visuals and both verified and grassroots influencers to spark widespread conversation. Custom content, from banners to reels, was tailored to each platform for consistent engagement. Powerful messaging and trending hashtags boosted visibility and built a strong emotional connection with the audience, positioning the release as socially relevant and buzzworthy.

TV show09 / 09

Shark Tank India

The Shark Tank India campaign delivered strong results across Facebook, Instagram and X (Twitter) with dynamic content, influencer collaborations and interactive strategies. Short-form videos, behind-the-scenes clips and real-time reactions sparked conversations and built excitement. The campaign surpassed its engagement goals, expanded reach and generated viral buzz. Content tailored to each platform and to entrepreneurial communities positioned Shark Tank India as a must-watch TV show.
